import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, rankdata
from scipy.stats import t as t_dist

def partial_spearman(x, y, z):
    """Partial Spearman correlation between x and y, controlling for z."""
    rx, ry, rz = rankdata(x), rankdata(y), rankdata(z)
    def residualize(r, rz):
        slope = np.polyfit(rz, r, 1)
        return r - np.polyval(slope, rz)
    rx_res = residualize(rx, rz)
    ry_res = residualize(ry, rz)
    rho = np.corrcoef(rx_res, ry_res)[0, 1]
    n = len(x)
    t = rho * np.sqrt((n - 3) / (1 - rho**2))
    p = 2 * t_dist.sf(abs(t), df=n-3)
    return rho, p

def analyze_model(model_name, cka_path, transfer_path, total_layers, method='mean_shift'):
    cka = pd.read_csv(cka_path)
    transfer = pd.read_csv(transfer_path)
    
    # Filter transfer to chosen method
    transfer = transfer[transfer['method'] == method].copy()
    
    # Merge on layer + language
    merged = cka.merge(transfer[['layer', 'language', 'auroc']], on=['layer', 'language'])
    merged['normalized_depth'] = merged['layer'] / total_layers
    
    n = len(merged)
    layers = sorted(merged['layer'].unique())
    languages = sorted(merged['language'].unique())
    
    print(f"=== {model_name} ===")
    print(f"Data: {n} observations, layers={layers}, languages={languages}")
    print(f"Transfer method: {method}")
    print()
    
    # 1. Raw Spearman
    rho_raw, p_raw = spearmanr(merged['cka_value'], merged['auroc'])
    print(f"Raw Spearman: rho={rho_raw:.4f}, p={p_raw:.4f} (n={n})")
    
    # 2. Partial Spearman controlling for depth
    rho_partial, p_partial = partial_spearman(
        merged['cka_value'].values, 
        merged['auroc'].values, 
        merged['normalized_depth'].values
    )
    print(f"Partial Spearman (ctrl depth): rho={rho_partial:.4f}, p={p_partial:.4f} (n={n})")
    print()
    
    # Also show: raw correlation of CKA with depth, and AUROC with depth
    rho_cka_depth, p_cka_depth = spearmanr(merged['cka_value'], merged['normalized_depth'])
    rho_auroc_depth, p_auroc_depth = spearmanr(merged['auroc'], merged['normalized_depth'])
    print(f"CKA ~ depth:    rho={rho_cka_depth:.4f}, p={p_cka_depth:.4f}")
    print(f"AUROC ~ depth:  rho={rho_auroc_depth:.4f}, p={p_auroc_depth:.4f}")
    print()
    
    # 3. Per-layer cross-language correlation
    print("Per-layer cross-language Spearman(CKA, AUROC):")
    per_layer_results = []
    for layer in layers:
        sub = merged[merged['layer'] == layer]
        if len(sub) >= 3:
            rho_l, p_l = spearmanr(sub['cka_value'], sub['auroc'])
            print(f"  Layer {layer:2d} (depth={layer/total_layers:.2f}): rho={rho_l:+.3f}, p={p_l:.3f} (n={len(sub)})")
            per_layer_results.append((layer, rho_l, p_l, len(sub)))
        else:
            print(f"  Layer {layer:2d}: insufficient data (n={len(sub)})")
    
    # Median per-layer rho
    if per_layer_results:
        median_rho = np.median([r[1] for r in per_layer_results])
        print(f"  Median per-layer rho: {median_rho:+.3f}")
    
    print()
    return {
        'raw_rho': rho_raw, 'raw_p': p_raw,
        'partial_rho': rho_partial, 'partial_p': p_partial,
        'cka_depth_rho': rho_cka_depth, 'auroc_depth_rho': rho_auroc_depth,
        'per_layer': per_layer_results, 'n': n
    }

# ============================================================
# Run analysis
# ============================================================

print("=" * 60)
print("PARTIAL CORRELATION PILOT: CKA vs Transfer AUROC")
print("Controlling for depth confound")
print("=" * 60)
print()

qwen_results = analyze_model(
    "Qwen2.5-7B (mvp_001)",
    "/root/xling_calib_direction/results_cka_mvp001/cka_matrix_qwen25_7b.csv",
    "/root/xling_calib_direction/results/transfer_results.csv",
    total_layers=27  # layers 0-27
)

llama_results = analyze_model(
    "Llama-3.1-8B (mvp_003)",
    "/root/xling_calib_direction/results_cka_mvp003/cka_matrix_llama31_8b.csv",
    "/root/xling_calib_direction/results_mvp003/transfer_results.csv",
    total_layers=31  # layers 0-31
)

# ============================================================
# Also run with zero_shot for comparison
# ============================================================
print("=" * 60)
print("COMPARISON: Using zero_shot method")
print("=" * 60)
print()

qwen_zs = analyze_model(
    "Qwen2.5-7B (zero_shot)",
    "/root/xling_calib_direction/results_cka_mvp001/cka_matrix_qwen25_7b.csv",
    "/root/xling_calib_direction/results/transfer_results.csv",
    total_layers=27,
    method='zero_shot'
)

llama_zs = analyze_model(
    "Llama-3.1-8B (zero_shot)",
    "/root/xling_calib_direction/results_cka_mvp003/cka_matrix_llama31_8b.csv",
    "/root/xling_calib_direction/results_mvp003/transfer_results.csv",
    total_layers=31,
    method='zero_shot'
)

# ============================================================
# Conclusion
# ============================================================
print("=" * 60)
print("CONCLUSION")
print("=" * 60)
print()

for name, res in [("Qwen (mean_shift)", qwen_results), ("Llama (mean_shift)", llama_results)]:
    raw_sig = "***" if res['raw_p'] < 0.001 else "**" if res['raw_p'] < 0.01 else "*" if res['raw_p'] < 0.05 else "ns"
    partial_sig = "***" if res['partial_p'] < 0.001 else "**" if res['partial_p'] < 0.01 else "*" if res['partial_p'] < 0.05 else "ns"
    print(f"{name}:")
    print(f"  Raw:     rho={res['raw_rho']:+.4f} ({raw_sig})")
    print(f"  Partial: rho={res['partial_rho']:+.4f} ({partial_sig})")
    attenuation = 1 - abs(res['partial_rho']) / abs(res['raw_rho']) if abs(res['raw_rho']) > 0.01 else float('nan')
    print(f"  Attenuation: {attenuation*100:.1f}%")
    print()

# Final verdict
both_partial_sig = qwen_results['partial_p'] < 0.05 and llama_results['partial_p'] < 0.05
both_partial_marginal = qwen_results['partial_p'] < 0.10 and llama_results['partial_p'] < 0.10
if both_partial_sig:
    verdict = "YES — CKA has independent explanatory power beyond depth in both models"
elif both_partial_marginal:
    verdict = "MARGINAL — partial correlations trend in expected direction but weak significance"
else:
    verdict = "NO — depth confound explains most/all of the CKA-transfer correlation"
    
print(f"Does CKA have independent explanatory power controlling for depth?")
print(f"  → {verdict}")
